# The Anti-Matrix Project

The Anti-Matrix Project is Gurman Singh's startup systems and execution practice. Gurman works with founder-led companies across Fractional Founder's Office support, business operations, GTM and revenue systems, practical AI workflows, hiring systems, dashboards, and fundraising readiness.

## Primary pages
- [The story and services](https://theantimatrixproject.com/): An interactive introduction to Gurman's work, experience, services, and selected builds.
- [Ways to work together](https://theantimatrixproject.com/work): Plain-language services, method, and selected proof for founder-led startups.
- [Control Deck](https://theantimatrixproject.com/control-deck): Field notes, independent builds, tools, and music.

## How Gurman works
Gurman helps founders diagnose where execution is getting stuck, assign ownership, build workflows and reporting, and turn decisions into follow-through. AI is used where it reduces repetitive work or improves decisions, not as a product in itself.

## Experience
His background includes CEO's Office work at AdPushup/Zelto, strategy and publisher operations with adops.space, startup consulting through The Anti-Matrix Project, and founder-led ventures in hospitality, the creator economy, and D2C.
